steps.title: Define Project Identity
steps.description: Establish application package metadata and set internal app identifier to 'com.uniqtool.app' with application name 'Uniq Tool'.

steps.title: Configure Build Parameters
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with precise build tools version 34.0.0, SDK target 34, and compile compatibility with Java 8.

steps.title: Configure Manifest Permissions and Configurations
steps.description: Establish the application entry points, package namespaces, launcher metadata, and custom layout orientation attributes.

steps.title: Design Application Layout Structure
steps.description: Draft the user interface layout in XML, providing scrollable input text views, visual option check boxes, statistical indicators, and clear trigger buttons.

steps.title: Instate Component Initializations
steps.description: Initialize user interface elements, view variables, and handle setup parameters programmatically inside MainActivity.

steps.title: Implement Text Normalization Logic
steps.description: Create strict text normalization filters supporting leading/trailing trim capabilities and case insensitivity toggles dynamically.

steps.title: Implement Consecutive Duplicate Filtering
steps.description: Write standard Unix-style sequential deduplication logic to preserve first-encounters and drop adjacent repeating values.

steps.title: Implement Global Unique Extraction
steps.description: Develop full-text deduplication algorithms tracking occurrences globally across the document using LinkedHashMap structures.

steps.title: Integrate Sorting Options
steps.description: Deploy sorting protocols utilizing robust, Java 8-compliant inline custom comparators.

steps.title: Deploy Mock Data Loader
steps.description: Add a mock payload feature containing consecutive and multi-occurrence values for easy app evaluation.

steps.title: Deploy Clipboard and Sharing Capabilities
steps.description: Configure copy-to-clipboard functionality and Android system share intent triggers to export processed text easily.

steps.title: Verify Code Cleanliness
steps.description: Audit components to verify zero usage of prohibited external libraries, non-standard imports, or modern non-compatible Java features.

steps.title: Building Uniq Tool
steps.description: Compile the code using native command arguments to bundle the finalized debug executable packages.
